listing.name: NHL 14 — bardown (griby-man)
listing.summary: The maintainer and a friend report completing the listed offline modes. Portcove has not confirmed those results. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own NHL 14 Xbox 360 disc ISO or extracted full disc files. Base disc, title 454109BE; no TU.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the project’s Linux AppImage or Windows ZIP to import your own NHL 14 base ISO or extracted folder. Setup translates shaders locally. Title updates are not accepted.

warnings: The maintainer and a friend report completing the listed offline modes. Portcove has not confirmed those results.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
